title: Characterizing finite posets whose probabilistic powerdomain are RB-domains
summary: We classify the finite posets whose probabilistic powerdomain is an RB-domain. For a finite nonempty poset \(P\), let \(\Vone(P)\) be the probability powerdomain of $P$, which is the probability simplex ordered by the stochastic order. We prove that \(\Vone(P)\) is an RB-domain if and only if \(P\) has a least element and the undirected Hasse graph of \(P\) is a tree. Consequently, the probabilistic powerdomain does not preserve RB-domains; the four-point diamond gives a finite counterexample. The proof separates two obstructions.
